name: First Contact
description: Defeat the first stage boss.

name: Mixed Salvo
description: Destroy one enemy with a torpedo and another with the secondary weapon during the same life.

name: On the Board
description: Defeat the first boss and finish the run with a ranked score.

name: Cast Off
description: Destroy your first enemy with a torpedo.

name: Depth Charge
description: Destroy your first enemy with the secondary weapon.

name: Dockyard Refit
description: Collect your first torpedo upgrade.

name: Contact Report
description: Destroy 20 enemies across arcade runs.

name: Second Watch
description: Enter the second stage.

name: Under Pressure
description: Defeat a boss after losing a submarine during that encounter.

name: Opening Salvo
description: Defeat the opening boss in a ranked Boss Rush.

name: Sea Trials
description: Score a kill with each upgraded torpedo type across your runs: Power, Wave and Spread.

name: Steady Helm
description: Clear a full stage from entry to exit without losing your submarine.

name: Wolf Pack
description: Play a full stage together and defeat its boss with both players still on their original lives for that stage.

name: Back to Port
description: Reach an arcade ending. Continues are allowed.

name: Raising the Bar
description: Beat a previously recorded personal best in a ranked run after defeating at least one boss.

name: Salvo Drill
description: Destroy 25 enemies with the secondary weapon during one life.

name: Battle Stations
description: Clear three stages in one run.

name: Broadside
description: Defeat a boss with a secondary-weapon finishing hit.

name: Half Watch
description: Reach the fourth boss of a ranked Boss Rush.

name: Deep Soundings
description: Finish a ranked run after clearing three stages.

name: One Credit Under the Sea
description: Reach an ending from a fresh solo start without continuing or adding a second player.

name: Three Down
description: Defeat three consecutive bosses in one ranked run without losing a life.

name: Clear Waters
description: Defeat the final boss in a ranked Boss Rush.

name: Iron Watch
description: Clear three consecutive full stages without losing a submarine.

name: Hard to Port
description: Reach an ending on Hard with default lives and at most one continue.

name: Torpedo Discipline
description: Clear a full stage using only torpedoes, including the boss, without losing a life.

name: Salvage Crew
description: Defeat three distinct bosses with a secondary-weapon finishing hit in one run.

name: Double Hull
description: Start together and clear three consecutive stages with neither player losing a submarine.

name: Full Manifest
description: Finish the entire campaign in ranked Score Attack.

name: Fleet in Reserve
description: Clear a ranked Boss Rush with at most one life lost.

name: Pressure Hull
description: Clear a ranked Boss Rush without losing a life.

name: Silent Running
description: Clear the campaign on Normal or Hard with default starting lives, without losing a submarine.

name: Abyssal Command
description: Complete 10 solo one-credit clears on Hard with default starting lives.

name: Torpedo School
description: Finish 15 solo one-credit campaigns on Normal or Hard, scoring kills with Power, Wave and Spread torpedoes in each run.

name: Perfect Charts
description: Clear every campaign stage without losing a life on Hard, three times per stage across solo runs.

name: Convoy Duty
description: Start together and finish five campaigns on Normal or Hard with default lives and no continues by either player.

name: Deep Patrol
description: Complete 50 ranked Boss Rush clears, including five without losing a life.

name: Unbroken Line
description: Clear three consecutive ranked Boss Rush attempts without losing a life. Quitting or restarting breaks the streak.

name: Victory Ledger
description: Complete 25 full campaigns in ranked Score Attack.

name: Clean Sweep
description: Complete five ranked Score Attack campaigns without losing a submarine.
